scripts.dev: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @amp/api" "npm run dev -w @amp/web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run db:migrate -w @amp/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run db:seed -w @amp/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run build -w @amp/api && npm run build -w @amp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @amp/api && npm run typecheck -w @amp/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run test -w @amp/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:dev && npm run test:web && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:built
scripts.accounts: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run accounts -w @amp/api --
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -k -n api,web "tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json scripts/e2e-server.ts" "npm run dev -w @amp/web -- --port 5175"
scripts.benchmark: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.db:showcase: npm run build -w @amp/contracts && npm run db:showcase -w @amp/api
